breakdowns.site: Sanand Project Site — Genie Z-45 Height Limit Switch Breakdown & VIP Plant Lockdown Fleet Overhaul (Units 150, 125, 100)
breakdowns.issue: (1) Genie Z-45 articulated boom lift (serial ending in 92) suffered a breakdown due to failure of the upper height limit switches ('height limit switch kaam nahi kar raha hai'). Breakdown logged and formal email dispatched. (2) Three major machines (150ft boom, 125ft boom, 100ft boom) were released from project contract. However, the plant is in total security lockdown for a VIP Chief Minister visit/inauguration ('CM aane wale hain, parking band kar rakhi hai, pura safai chal raha hai'). Client demands machines be evacuated immediately. Evacuating machines outside creates external parking rental and crane loading expenses.
breakdowns.action: Minor repairs feasible within premises are being executed inside: Unit 125 limit switch wiring and Unit 100 rotor servicing (removing temporary bypass wiring to ensure proper long-term reliability). For Unit 150 (requiring swing motor seal, main boom cylinder seal from Pradeep, and load cell overhaul), Vinod Pal and Banarasi Yadav instructed to confirm with Vinay Singh whether to park outside or retain inside until VIP event concludes. Jitendra instructed that no machine shall be dispatched to the next site without 100% mechanical overhaul regardless of loading expenses.
breakdowns.logistics: Swing motor seal, boom cylinder seal, and load cells ready; transport loading trailer coordination on standby.
breakdowns.clarification: Client warned not to allow machines to sit un-serviced; comprehensive servicing before next mobilization is mandatory.
breakdowns.status: Operational Challenge — Z-45 Limit Switch Failure; Plant Lockdown for CM Visit; Servicing of Units 150, 125 & 100 Underway
breakdowns.pendingIssue: Clearance of plant access post-VIP inauguration; seal fitment on Unit 150.

breakdowns.site: Mundra Project Site — A-45 Electric Boom Lift Battery Voltage Collapse & Overload Cut-Off (Unit 5390 / Serial 3370441)
breakdowns.issue: Machine 5390 is repeatedly breaking down during operation. When lifting to a height of 2 to 3 feet, the platform errors out and registers an artificial overload code ('2-3 foot height me jaati hai aur overload batane lagti hai'). Chunnilal reported the machine only runs for 2 to 2.5 hours before total battery collapse. The unit previously received 4 replacement batteries while retaining 4 old weak batteries, leading to severe cell unbalance and failure during drive/lift draw.
breakdowns.action: Shiv Uniyal clarified that 8 brand new, factory-packed large 6V Surya traction batteries are already physically available in stock under Khemchand's custody. Khemchand instructed to arrange immediate dispatch of all 8 new batteries to Mundra. Field engineers Manish Patel and Sandeep arriving on site today to assist Chunnilal and Mantu Dada, with technical guidance from Anil over video call.
breakdowns.logistics: 8 brand new Surya batteries being transferred from depot storage to Mundra.
breakdowns.clarification: Management rejected piecemeal 4-battery replacements for heavy electric boom lifts; a full matched set of 8 batteries is essential for voltage stability under hydraulic load.
breakdowns.status: Critical Breakdown — Severe Voltage Sag at 2-3ft Elevation; 8 Brand New Surya Batteries Dispatched for Complete Bank Overhaul
breakdowns.pendingIssue: Installation of 8 new batteries and loaded calibration with hydrometer report.

breakdowns.site: Mundra Project Site — JLG 800AJ Corroded Spares Crisis & Client Dehire Ultimatum
breakdowns.issue: Severe operational crisis: client issued a formal ultimatum threatening to cancel the rental contract and dehire the 800AJ unit ('client release karne ki dhamki de diya... bangar utha lo agar nahi banwana hai'). Spares procured from a third-party Bombay vendor arrived covered in rust/corrosion and did not meet specifications ('saman pahuncha hai, usme zang laga hua hai'). Mantu Dada rightfully rejected the parts and ordered them returned.
breakdowns.rootCause: Parts were sourced from an unverified vendor because their quotation was Rs 8,000 to Rs 10,000 cheaper than standard suppliers. However, the machine has now been grounded for 8-10 days, costing Rs 2,000 freight in transit each way, while generating massive client dissatisfaction and rental revenue loss. The vendor substitution occurred because Reach International has outstanding unpaid credit balances with primary suppliers ('udhari / payment nahi kara pate').
breakdowns.action: Heated discussion between Vinay Singh, Shiv Uniyal, Pardeep Tomar, and Jitendra Budhauliya. Teams agreed that chasing minor discounts at the expense of part quality and equipment uptime is unacceptable. Shiv confirmed defective parts are being returned; usable components to be cleaned with diesel if feasible, while trusted replacement spares are expedited immediately to prevent contract termination.
breakdowns.logistics: Reverse logistics arranged for rusted consignment; priority replacement PO to be processed.
breakdowns.clarification: Management emphasized that procurement savings must never override delivery speed and OEM metallurgical quality.
breakdowns.status: Client Escalation — Dehire Threat Issued; Rusted Spares Consignment Rejected; Emergency Supplier Replacements Expedited
breakdowns.pendingIssue: Delivery of OEM-spec replacement spares and immediate installation by Mantu Dada.

breakdowns.site: Mundra Project Site — Z-40 Hydraulic Pump Fitment & Client Gate Pass PF Number Bottleneck
breakdowns.issue: Machine Z-40 is grounded awaiting a replacement hydraulic pump. Pardeep Tomar confirmed the pump was ordered for direct site delivery and has arrived. However, technician entry to the plant is blocked because client security requires a valid Provident Fund (PF) number and formal company joining letter for gate pass issuance ('bina PF number ke gate pass nahi banega'). Mantu Dada previously used an emergency gate pass to enter.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya and Sushil Mishra instructed to retrieve the technician's PF records and generate the requisite documentation today so the gate pass can be cleared and the hydraulic pump installed immediately.
breakdowns.logistics: Direct-shipped hydraulic pump verified at site gate.
breakdowns.status: Blocked at Site Entry — Hydraulic Pump Delivered; Gate Pass Pending PF Number Verification
breakdowns.pendingIssue: HR verification of PF number and completion of pump installation.

breakdowns.site: Delhi Metro Fleet & Regional Projects — Battery Shortage, Hydraulic Stoppages & Spares Tracking (Rahul Singh)
breakdowns.issue: (1) Rahul Singh expressed extreme frustration regarding severe battery shortages for 4550 and 3240 scissor/boom lifts ('4550 ki battery bhejwa de yaar, khali gaali khate rahe hum log'). Pardeep Tomar confirmed central inventory has zero stock of 4550 batteries currently; new stock expected by Monday. (2) A metro machine broke down on the platform at night due to hydraulic loss; field crew borrowed hydraulic oil on short-term local credit to extract the machine; Ambreesh dispatched to execute full inspection. (3) Bhiwani site reported a breakdown; technician Vikas dispatched to inspect. (4) Haldiram project machine: wiring harness arrived but electronic card is still pending; a diesel replacement unit was mobilized as an interim measure to avoid client penalty.
breakdowns.action: Ambreesh instructed to inspect Metro fleet machines thoroughly; Vikas to report on Bhiwani site status; Pardeep Tomar to expedite Monday arrival of fresh battery consignments.
breakdowns.logistics: Diesel substitute machine staged at Haldiram; Ambreesh mobilized for Metro night breakdown follow-up.
breakdowns.status: Active Maintenance — Battery Stock Exhausted until Monday; Ambreesh & Vikas Mobilized; Diesel Backup Deployed at Haldiram
breakdowns.pendingIssue: Monday battery arrival and electronic card delivery for Haldiram unit.

directives.title: Quality First in Spare Parts Procurement (Strict Ban on Substandard Sourcing)
points: Elimination of Counterfeit or Corroded Spares: Sourcing components from secondary unverified vendors to save negligible amounts (e.g., Rs 8,000–10,000 on 800AJ) that result in rusted, unusable parts and 10 days of machine downtime is completely unacceptable.
Supplier Qualification & Reliability: Critical breakdown components must be procured exclusively from approved suppliers who guarantee factory warranty and rapid dispatch.

directives.title: Zero Compromise on Fleet Overhauls Prior to Re-Mobilization
points: Mandatory 100% Pre-Dispatch Overhaul: Machines released from client contracts (e.g., Sanand Units 150, 125, 100) must undergo complete mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic servicing before being mobilized to new project sites.
Operational Discipline Over Logistics Convenience: Saving on external parking or trailer loading costs must never take precedence over executing comprehensive maintenance.

directives.title: Strict Pre-Purchase Verification & Vendor Credit Clearance Policy
points: Pre-Purchase Authorization Mandate: Technicians are strictly prohibited from taking goods on credit from local shops without prior authorization. To clear the current Rs 47,000–50,000 vendor credit backlog, technicians must call Pardeep Tomar directly prior to taking material, with payment processed within 1 hour.
Reimbursement Processing SLA: Genuine technician expense vouchers for couriers and emergency hardware must be cleared promptly to avoid placing financial burdens on field crews.

directives.title: Mandatory Complete Battery Bank Replacement for Electric Heavy Booms
points: Matched Battery Bank Standard: Heavy electric boom lifts (such as A-45 / Unit 5390) must receive a full set of 8 brand new matched batteries. Partial replacements of 4 batteries paired with aging cells cause severe voltage unbalance, false overload trips, and recurring downtime.
Quantitative Pre-Commissioning Tests: Specific gravity and voltage under load must be logged across all 8 batteries prior to declaring the unit operational.
